billingNotice.title: Billed by your agency
billingNotice.description: This blog is part of an agency subscription. Its credits and AI budget come from the agency's shared pool.

create.title: Create an agency account
create.description: One subscription for all your clients' blogs. Each blog runs on Pro or Premium and shares article credits with the others, or stays on Free at no cost.
create.name: Agency name
create.headline: Every client blog, one credit pool

benefits.title: Shared credits
benefits.text: All blogs draw from one pool. Give any blog a monthly limit.

benefits.title: One invoice
benefits.text: Monthly in USD, with a per-blog usage report for billing your clients.

benefits.title: One team, every blog
benefits.text: Invite colleagues once and they can work on every agency blog.

benefits.title: Nothing goes to waste
benefits.text: Unused credits carry over, up to twice the monthly amount.

create.footnote: Prices exclude VAT and are billed monthly. You can cancel at any time in billing.

plan.title: Subscription
plan.summary: {blogs} blogs and {units} credits a month for {price}.
plan.inactive: No active subscription. Choose how many blogs and credits you need.
plan.pastDue: The last payment failed. Update your payment method in billing so your blogs stay active.
plan.increaseNote: The difference for the rest of this period is charged now and the extra credits are added right away.
plan.decreaseNote: Lower quantities apply from the next invoice. The current period is not refunded.
plan.ownerOnly: Only agency owners can change the subscription.
plan.pendingPayment: Pay the open invoice to complete the change.
plan.minimum: At least {blogs} blogs and {blocks} credit packs.
plan.summaryPremium: {blogs} blogs ({premium} Premium) and {units} credits a month for {price}.

blogs.title: Blogs
blogs.empty: No blogs yet. Create a new one or add a blog you own.
blogs.limitHelp: The blog stops generating once it reaches the limit. The shared pool stays available to the other blogs.
blogs.detachText: The blog moves to the Free plan and your agency team loses access to it. Its articles stay.
blogs.noFreeSlot: All blog slots are in use. Add the blog on Free, or add more blogs to the subscription.

blogs.period: Credits and published articles this period
blogs.noSlot: No free blog slot. Add one in the subscription.
blogs.noPremiumSlot: No free Premium add-on. Add one in the subscription.
blogs.toFreeText: AI, scheduled articles and the custom domain stop, and the blog moves to its Topiqu address. Content and team access stay. After an upgrade, reconnect the domain and turn the schedule back on.
blogs.toProText: Premium features stop, including SEO autopilot and AI visibility. The autopilot has to be turned on again after an upgrade.
blogs.createTitle: The blog joins the agency on {plan}
blogs.createText: It is billed through the agency, so it needs no plan or card of its own. You can change its plan in the list of blogs.
blogs.createAttachFailed: The blog was created but could not join the agency. Add it below.
blogs.emptyInactive: Once the subscription is active, create blogs here or add ones you own.

members.title: Agency team
members.description: Members get access to every agency blog. Owners also manage billing, blogs and people.
members.emailHelp: The person needs a Topiqu account with a verified email address.
members.removeText: They lose access to every agency blog at once.
